image_description: A Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming in a marine environment. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a golden yellow posterior body and tail. It is positioned near coral structures, with a brain coral visible in the lower left.
